description: Full detail for one Troostwijk lot within its auction: auction description, current/final bid, sale outcome, bid count, location. auction_slug comes from a search/sold-comps result url (the part after /en/a/); pass display_id to pick a specific lot out of a multi-lot auction (omit for a single-lot auction). Sourced from troostwijkauctions.com/en/a/{auction_slug}.

display_id.description: Optional specific lot display id within a multi-lot auction, e.g. "A1-46249-6" (from a search result's display_id field)

name: troostwijk_lot_detail
title: Troostwijk Lot Detail
